WITH finder(str) AS (
      SELECT (SELECT max(k) FROM t1 WHERE k<='abatementt')
        UNION ALL
        SELECT (
          SELECT max(k) FROM t1 
          WHERE k<=substr('abatementt', 1, prefix_length(finder.str, 'abatementt'))
        ) FROM finder WHERE length(finder.str)>0
      )
    SELECT str FROM finder WHERE length(str)==prefix_length(str, 'abatementt') LIMIT 1
